title: Varro, De lingua Latina, Books V–VII — On the Latin Language; Варрон, «О латинском языке» (RU-gap)
author: M. Terentius Varro
size: Books V–VII est. 25–30k words (Books V–X survive; estimate)
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia: only excerpts from Books VIII–X (Я. М. Боровский, «Античные теории языка и стиля», 1936) plus a 1975 excerpt (Каракулаков). Books V–VII apparently untranslated
en_evidence: R. G. Kent, Loeb (1938); W. de Melo, OUP 2019 (text, translation and commentary), per en.wikipedia
value: Books V–VII etymologise places, gods, institutions and poetic words. A primary source for Roman topography, religion and early Latin poetry, used by historians, archaeologists and linguists
ai_feasibility: high — use the English versions only for cross-checking; etymologies need explanatory notes
